doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: Family pictures, Panama City and Florida relatives
summary: Billie shows pictures of a nephew trombonist, relatives in Florida, a 1944 postcard from Panama City where they played, a Mexico card and a church.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren
